top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the physiology of GLP-1, identification of its active form and its glucose-dependent insulinotropic action, a mechanism confirmed for over two decades and validated by randomized outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. The discovery-side allocation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov fits a category that rewards discovery; the open question is Mojsov's priority relative to Habener, and Knudsen would be the pre-stated substitute if documentary evidence showed her contribution was not independent. A contested credit is not a reason to leave undone an award with unanimous scientific support, so no award ranks last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for any credited name on B027; roughly twenty co-authored works with Thomas Perlmann and a postdoc with Paul Greengard do not concern any credited candidate
